description: Exact text of the dasakam 12 S003 v008 visual review record removed from art/reviews/visual-reviews.json when the selected-version records were rebuilt for v010 (source commit 0be978f). Also lists the independent reports for superseded S003 candidates: reviewer A's report covering v008 and reviewer d's needs-fix report covering v009. Preserved history only; these records do not clear any current selection.

reviews.anatomy_basis: Brahma follows his four-arm, four-head contract; Varaha uses the natural four-legged boar form. Ordinary human figures retain two arms.

limbs_hands_feet.observations: Brahma’s four arms remain distinct; the single small boar has four connected legs and feet. No extra or fused digits were apparent in the enlarged detail.

attachment_proportions.observations: Brahma’s limbs connect to the torso; the boar reads as one small animal with a coherent body.

faces.observations: Brahma has three separate visible faces; the boar has a natural snout, ears and eye without human infant features.

duplication_fusion.observations: The one boar is separate from Brahma, with no duplicate boar or merged figure.

text_artifacts.observations: The open field, water and corners show no readable text, signature, logo or watermark.

scene_style_continuity.observations: Prayerful Brahma, the nostril-linked tiny crowned boar and sinking Earth cue match the plan; the boar floats above the receiving hand as disclosed in the plan.
